purpose: Concept A partnership artwork; decorative conceptual objects, not product or customer evidence

assets.brief: Transparent cutout of two overlapping thick frosted-glass circular medallions connected by a clear curved glass ribbon. Pearl-white blank faces, softly blue edges, warm daylight. No logos, text, scene or floor. Official platform marks are separate HTML images.

Transparent cutout of three gently fanned pearl-white calendar sculptures. Soft blue edges, embossed blank date squares, one tiny blue check. No numbers, text, prices or software UI. Same warm daylight and tactile material family as the glass assembly.

assets.notes: Unmodified official SVG. Replaces the pre-existing 32px PNG in the larger artwork only.

assets.brief: Single optical glass medallion derived from the approved assembly, with sage refraction and warm ivory daylight. Transparent blank face; official platform marks remain separate unmodified SVGs. Instances compose into two independently moving foreground objects.

Single pearl calendar derived from the approved stack, retaining embossed blank dates and blue checked day. Warm top-left illumination and cool blue edge. Transparent instances create the independently compressing three-layer stack.

encoding: Original assembly variants: WebP quality 88, alpha quality 100, widths 640 and 960. New independent v2 elements: same encoding at 400 and 800; generated masters retained in session image directory.
